--- Page 5 --- CHAPPA KA'ATHIPANI_AGANDAPANL Angni pagipa Pa Meckenson Rongmutu Sangma. A'chikni sea jotanirangna gisik nanggipa saksa ong'a.
Ua an'tangni janggi langani salrango bang'a krtaprangko seaha-jekai Sin'karini katta aro uandakgiparang.
Ua adita poctryrangkoba see donangaha jenmangoni iarang ong'a- (1) Song Baghmara (2)-Panteni gisik ra'ani (3) Randi Mechikni sintea (4) Pante bilsi chichet (5) Matchani sima nia aro gipinrang.
Unbaksana, ua mtam English ku'sikonikoba pe'skae see donangaha- jekai - (1)- Merchant or Venice (2) Mama Tomni jamdap. Uandake ua antangni chasongo.
jatni sea jolanirangna gisik nange see donanggparangoni mingsa ia daro chappa kaalenggipa ‘Riki Rikot Serikkot' ong'a.

Pa Meckenson Rongmutu Sangma, ia seanirangko me'apa chagitchamrangoniko wal'tim golpoarango knatimrike. sara nokkra ku'ritingrangoniko knarikna man'c, knalo chasong gitalrangba ma'sirikpachina inc se donangaha.
Uni uandake gisik nange knatimrike seani gitan ki'tapni bimungkoba 'Riki Rikot Serikot' ine mingaha.
Anga ia angni pagipa sagini ki'tapko chappa ka'na dakchakgipa plak ripengrangkon mitela. Anga ia seaniko press-o chappa ka'mittingo salrango gualanirangko nipilna dakchakanina Dr.
Julius L.R.
Marakko mitela.

Ia ki'tapko chappa ka'na an'tangni press-o kamrang jakchakjaoba dakchakanina M/S Singhania Offset Press, Shillong, dingtangmancha mitela. Ia ki'tapko poraie nigipa sakantian maiba namgniko ba skidapaniko dongja, indiba jekon Apa angna ia gamko donangaha ukosa A'chik jatni sea jotanirangko bariatna chappa ka'atenga.

Seanio maiba gualanirang dongode angna see u'iatpachina ia kitapko poraisoenggipa sakantiko mol'molata jedakode anga uarangko changgipin chappa ka'ataianio namdapatanirangko dongode on'dapatna man'gen.
Taraghar Bungalow, S.C. Marak, MLA Shillong-793 001 --- Page 6 --- AGANDAPANL.
(late) Pa Meckenson Rongmutu.
Pa Salseng C. Marak.
M.A-m pagipa.

A'chik jatni sea jotanrangna gisik nangbegipa saksa ong'a. Ua an'tangni u't ma'sianirangko an'tang baksa bon'atanggija, jatna, a'songna nangn ong'gniko nike aro jaini sea jotanrangko banatna miksonge see donangaha.
A'chik pagitcham, ma'gitchamrangni gisepo songo noko ha a'songtango donge, songsul roe noksul cha'c.
sara nokkra rogrike, wal'tin asong golpoe, ku'mong meligrike dongode, rokomari me'apa chagitchanrangni golpoarangko, agan ku'ritinganirangko knarikna nan'al.

Uamangni agan golpoanirang mitanrangde golposan ong'ja, chong'mot ong'a obostarangkoba gisik nangrikgipa chadamberangna aganange on'ronga. Meckenson Rongmitu, sakantini wal'tim golpoarangko, agan ku'rittingrangko gisik nang'be'e knatinmrike ia namnambcgipa chong'mot ong'a a'selrang jerangan jatni gisepo ong.angahachim, uarangko A'chik jatna see donangaha.
la mingantini katta bichongrangko poraic nigenchim ong'ode ma'sirikna man'gen.

Ua an'tangni sakantini dingtangdingtang agananirangko serikote aro sandirikote serikani kri bimungkoba, Riki Rikot Serikot' ine donaha, maina ua sakantini aganrikotanirangko serikote ra'rikaha. An'tangni pagipa Mekenson Rongmitu Sangmani donanga gamko galchipc donaigija, Pa Salseng C.
Marak.

MLA, jean jatni sea jotanina gisik nangbegipa ong'achim, dongrikenggipa A'chik chadamberang u'i ma'sirikpachina, jekon pagipa see donangaha, uko galchipe donaigija chappa ka'e parakataha. Pa Salseng C.
Marak, MLA aro Meghalaya Statc-ni Chief Minister ong'c, a'songko sason ka'engon kamrang uarangko bariatna gualjaha.
Uandake, pa Salseng C.

Marak, MLA an'tangni pajongtang (Late) Dewansing Rongmutu Sangmani see donanggipa ki'tap kinggni-Jadoreng (1993) aro The Traditional Dances of the Garos (1996) - rangkoba sandirikite jatna chappa ka'e on'aha. Uni uandake jatke a'songko silroro churoroatna jako ra'e sason ka'asan ong.aigija, leka poraianio, sea jotanio gisik nange bariatna Anga, Pa Salseng C.
Marak, MLA-ko ia agandapaniko sena cholko on'anina dingtangmacha mitela.

Songni Nokpante E9-19 [iv] --- Page 9 --- Serikkot Ming I: BIKPIL BAWIL SEOBA APSANGIPA KATTA WAJOL Chumonggipa:M Rongmuthu Napoleon an'tangni janggi tangao Europe gimikko chotchanggija dakgrikachi so'sojengjcng ong'atbeaha.

Changsaode biko French manderangan Mediterranean sagalo donggipa chongipa chichang ELBA minggipaona din-galaha. Ua Flba chichango sal 100 dongmitingo Napo leon ka'mao mesokgipa katta wa'joiko aganaha ina.
la katta wa'jola chu'sokgipa katta wajol ong'a.
la katta wa'jolni ong'ronggija ong'ania ian: Poratbewal jakasichini jakrachini poraio jedake ong'a uandaken jakrachini jakasichina poraioba apsan ong'a.
Da'o nibo, ABLEWASIEREISAW ELBA. Serikkot Ming 2: A-ONIZ-ONA ROMANOIKORDONGTOKGIPA KATTA WA'JOL.
Chmonggipa : M.Rongmuhu Ka'mao Mesokgipa katta wa'jol kandikgipa katta wa'jolsa ong'a Indiba na'a uano Roman oikor A-oni Z-ona dongtokako nikgen.

Da'o nibo enia oikorkoba A-oni Z-ona am'c nibo: A QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS OVER THE LAZY DOG. Ia kalta wa'jolo oikor A-oni Z-ona dongtokani gimin uko type dokako skiao on'ronga [1] --- Page 10 --- Serikkot Ming 3: JOLJOLPORAIOORTODINGTANG,RITTINGPRAK WATCHANGEPORAIOORTODINGTANG DAKGIPA KATTA WA'JOLRANG.
Chimonggipa : M.

Rongmuthu Ka'mao mesokgipa katta wa'jolrangko na'a poraibewal gita joljol poraiode orto gimikan jechakani ku'wajolrang ong'a. Indiba ritingprakprak watchang watchange poraiode kurachakani kattarang ong'a.

My dear, The great love I have hitherto expressed for you is false and I find my indifference towards you increases daily.The more I see of you the more I feel myseif every way disposed and determincd to hate you.
Believe me I never had an intention to offer you my hand.

Our last conversation has left a tidious insipience which has by no means given me the most exalted idea of your character: Your temper would make me extremely unhappy, and if we are united, I shall experience nothing but the hatred of my parents, added to everlasting dis- pleasure in living with you. I have, indeed, a heart to bestow, but I donot desire you to imagine it at your service.
I could not give it to anyone more inconsistent and capricious than yourself and not capable to do honour to my choice and to my family.
Yes, indeed, I hope you will be persuaded that I speak sincerely, and will do me a favour to avoid me. I shall excuse your taking the trouble to answer this.
Your letters are always full of imperinence and you have not a shadow of good sense of wit.
Adieu. Adieu.
Believe me.
My advice to you is that it is impossible for me, to be your most affectionate friend and humble servant.
